Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Species of gastropod Alvania belgica Scientific classification Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Mollusca Class: Gastropoda Subclass: Caenogastropoda Order: Littorinimorpha Superfamily: Rissooidea Family: Rissoidae Genus: Alvania Species: † A. belgica Binomial name † Alvania belgica Glibert, 1952 Alvania belgica is an extinct species of minute sea snail , a marine gastropod mollusc or micromollusk in the family Rissoidae . [ 1 ] Distribution [ edit ] Fossils of this species were found in Miocene strata in Belgium (age range: 15.97 to 11.608 Ma) References [ edit ] ^ MolluscaBase eds. (2024). MolluscaBase.
